dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Are the animals in Thailand in danger?
dialogue.reading: ər ði ˈænɪməlz ɪn ˈtaɪlænd ɪn ˈdeɪndʒər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Some are. Forests are disappearing, so animals are losing their homes.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ˈɑːr. ˈfɔːrɪsts ər ˌdɪsəˈpɪrɪŋ, soʊ ˈænɪməlz ər ˈluːzɪŋ ðɛr ˈhoʊmz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible. Which animals are endangered?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl. ˈwɪtʃ ˈænɪməlz ər ɪnˈdeɪndʒərd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Tigers, for example. And a lot of other species, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪɡərz, fər ɪɡˈzæmpəl. ənd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈʌðər ˈspiːʃiːz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Some people still hunt them. But things are getting better.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈstɪl ˈhʌnt ðɛm. bʌt ˈθɪŋz ər ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈbɛtər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: We're protecting more forests now, and the tigers are coming back.
dialogue.reading: wɪr prəˈtɛktɪŋ ˈmɔːr ˈfɔːrɪsts ˈnaʊ, ənd ðə ˈtaɪɡərz ər ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈbæk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's great! I'm happy to hear that.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt! aɪm ˈhæpi tə ˈhɪr ðæt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And young people are learning to protect nature, too.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl ər ˈlɜːrnɪŋ tə prəˈtɛkt ˈneɪtʃər, ˈtuː.
